svg.aria-label: B+ tree of order 4 built from the 24 sample cloud records
svg.text: B+ tree of order 4 built from the 24 sample cloud records
Internal nodes hold routing keys only. Every record lives in a leaf, and leaves are linked left to right.
Internal node: separator keys + child pointers (a signpost, no data)
Leaf node: keys + full CloudRecord for each key
next-pointer linking leaves in key order
Order m = 4 → at most 3 keys / 4 children per node
Every non-root node is at least half full (leaf ≥ 2 keys, internal ≥ 1 key)
All leaves are on the same level, so every lookup reads exactly 3 nodes
